g.text: Confirm, reject or re-link the agent-proposed matches for one new idea.
Idea IDX-2026-041 'Zero-sugar yuzu sparkling 330 ml can' (illustrative) has 2 possible matches. Review before the Friday Idea Log close.

PRJ-0311 Tracker row, Archive tab: killed at G1 for margin, not for consumer appeal.
IDX-2025-188 Idea Log row: Parked, review date 2027-02-15.
Review SLA: 3 working days | Reviewer: Innovation Project Manager (PM-I)
OVERRIDE REASON (required when you change the proposal)

g.text: Run the screening meeting: ideas above 60 and the proceed, park or reject vote.

Caffeine 165 mg/L in frozen recipe v3 vs limit 150 mg/L (rules library GCC-CAF-004, checklist EMEA 2026.1).
Registration is required for GCC; the status is read from the RA tracker.
Review SLA: Acknowledge 2 working days; decide within 5 | Reviewer: Regulatory Affairs Specialist; QA Lead for allergen findings

g.text: Release check and decision entry after the ISC chair states the outcome.
Close Turkey concept test before G3. RA to confirm GCC

Recommend Renovate: volume is ahead of baseline but NPV is behind because actual COGS exceeds the business case by 9%.
COGS actual vs business case: SAP CK11n and internal order actuals, dataset cell C14.
Volume variance by OpCo: ATS12 dataset table 2.

OVERRIDE REASON (required when you change the proposal)
How many ideas enter, get de-duplicated, score above 60 and proceed each month?
Where is every project in G0 to G5, what is holding it, and how full is the ISC agenda?
How do launches perform against the G2 baseline and are G5 reviews on schedule?
How often do reviewers accept, override or escalate AI proposals, and is any AI step ready for promotion?
